name: FullSeriesCollection
description: Represents the full collection of all chart series, both filtered and unfiltered.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified FullSeriesCollection object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of full series in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual full series item from the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the item to return.
